items.t: Head gasket failure or slipped cylinder liner
items.job: Replace head gaskets and resurface heads
items.note: Owners reported $1,600-$4,800 for head gasket work. A slipped liner needs an engine rebuild or replacement, which costs far more.

items.t: Main bearing failure and low oil pressure
items.job: Rebuild engine bottom end (bearings, crankshaft service)
items.note: CarComplaints lists an average cost of about $3,500 for this repair.

items.t: Oil pump failure
items.note: Owners reported about $1,500-$1,700, sometimes with the water pump and belt done at the same time.

items.t: Overheating from clogged radiator or failed water pump
items.job: Replace radiator (or water pump) and flush coolant
items.note: Owners reported $450-$800 for a radiator and $750 for a water pump.

items.t: ABS, traction control and hill descent lights all on
items.job: Diagnose ABS fault and replace wheel speed sensor or ABS module
items.note: One owner spent about C$1,500 twice on diagnosis without a lasting fix, so choose a Land Rover specialist.

items.t: Oil leaks from valve covers and oil pan
items.job: Replace valve cover and oil pan gaskets
items.note: Owners reported $350-$1,800 depending on how many gaskets were done.

items.t: Driveshaft vibration from worn U-joints or rear coupling
items.note: One owner paid about $1,070 for a rebuilt front driveshaft plus a fuse box.

items.t: Cruise control wire can set off driver airbag (recall)
Air suspension compressor failure
items.note: Owners reported $700-$2,500. Remanufactured compressors cost less than new.

items.t: Air strut leak or height sensor fault
items.job: Replace one air strut or ride height sensor
items.note: Owners reported about $600-$2,000 for struts and $1,200-$2,200 for height sensors with programming.

items.t: Wheel bearing or hub failure
items.job: Replace front or rear wheel bearing/hub (one side)
items.note: Owners reported about $1,350-$2,000 per bearing at dealers.

items.t: Worn control arm bushings and ball joints
items.job: Replace front lower control arms (pair) and align
items.note: Owners reported $1,000-$2,800; quality OEM-grade arms last longer.

items.t: Thermostat housing cracks and leaks coolant
items.note: Owners reported $110-$1,600, with the higher numbers including other cooling parts.

items.t: Water pump leak
items.note: Owners reported $500-$1,300 for the pump alone.

items.t: Coolant leak from plastic crossover pipes
items.note: One owner paid about $2,500 for a water pump plus upgraded crossover hoses.

items.t: Electronic parking brake sticks or fails
items.job: Replace parking brake actuator and shoes
items.note: Owners reported about $930-$2,700, higher when rear brakes were damaged.

items.t: Transmission fault message from rear locker motor
items.note: One owner paid about $3,200 when the whole locking differential was replaced.

items.t: Clogged sunroof drains flood wiring
items.job: Clear drains and dry/repair water-damaged wiring
items.note: Owners reported $1,500-$4,000 for water damage; drain cleaning alone is cheap.

items.t: Alternator failure
items.note: Owners reported $700-$1,200.

items.t: Transmission fluid leaks
items.job: Replace transmission pan/gasket or connector sleeve and refill
items.note: Owners reported $570-$2,400.

items.t: Battery drains and won't start
Driver airbag wiring can break (recall)
Fuel tank outlet flange can crack and leak (recall)
Rear doors may not latch (recall)
Check engine light from exhaust manifold leak
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold gasket or manifold
items.note: One owner paid $800 and then $500 on later visits.

items.t: Engine can shut off after false low-fuel reading (recall)
No dashboard sign when auto high beams are on (recall)
Loose battery ground can cut power (recall)
DC/DC converter overload can cut drive power (recall)
Rear camera can fill with water (recall)
Driver airbag clockspring connector can corrode (recall)
Blocked cam carrier oil channel can leak oil (recall)
Oil filter housing can crack and leak (recall)
'Traction reduced' warning in low range or off-road mode
items.job: Diagnose and apply bulletin repair (usually software)
items.note: Normally covered by the new-vehicle warranty.

items.t: Keyless entry and walk-away locking work only sometimes
items.note: Normally covered by the new-vehicle warranty.
